texto.muro: a tall wall of vertical oak acoustic slats, each batten casting its own fine shadow line

escena: SCENE (a working session, studio in Santiago, morning): he wears a WHITE PIQUÉ POLO SHIRT that is COMPLETELY PLAIN — verify it: there is NO embroidery, NO emblem, NO logo, NO badge and NO mark of any kind anywhere on the garment; the left chest panel is bare white piqué, evenly lit, facing the lens in a gentle three-quarter turn and FULLY VISIBLE, not covered by an arm and not in deep shadow. The fabric's piqué texture is legible. He is RECEIVING, not speaking: mouth closed, gaze lowered and going out of frame to the left, one hand near his jaw, body still. He sits LOW in the lower half of the frame. A hard shaft of morning sun lands on him and the desk; the reserved slat wall above stays in its own even shadow, outside the beam. An AZURE-BLUE screen glows out of frame at the left. Caught AT THE INSTANT he tilts his head a degree to catch a word. 85mm at f/1.8.

lecho.objeto: a stack of matte black sample boxes right against the lens, unlit
